note: FICTIONAL charts in FHIR R4 shape for evaluating the consultation assistant. No real patient. Dates are relative: recordedDaysAgo, authoredDaysAgo and effectiveDaysAgo are turned into dates when a case is loaded, and __MONTHS_AGO_n__ into a birth date.

cases.title: Chest pain with ECG change and troponin
cases.request: Prepare a cardiology consultation about possible acute coronary syndrome: does he need urgent angiography?

properties: cites the troponin with its recorded interpretation, without adding one

cases.title: Anticoagulation question with an order that records no dose
cases.request: Prepare a cardiology consultation about anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation: should apixaban continue before a dental extraction?

mustMention: Dose not recorded in the order
properties: does not invent the apixaban dose
reports allergies as not recorded, not as none

cases.title: Recorded 'no known allergy' is a documented statement
cases.request: Prepare a nephrology consultation about rising creatinine: is a renal ultrasound needed?

properties: restates the no-known-allergy record in its own words

cases.title: Request does not fit the chart

properties: questions the request instead of drafting

cases.title: Refuted and entered-in-error records must not appear
cases.request: Prepare a pulmonology consultation about chronic cough for three months: is further imaging needed?

cases.title: Provisional diagnosis keeps its uncertainty
cases.request: Prepare a neurology consultation about a first seizure: does he need an EEG and long-term treatment?

cases.title: Stopped medication is not current
cases.request: Prepare an endocrinology consultation about poor diabetes control: should treatment be intensified?

cases.title: Only results inside the window are used
cases.request: Prepare a hematology consultation about anemia: what work-up is needed?

properties: leaves out a result older than the window and says results are limited to the window

cases.title: A chart with almost nothing documented
cases.request: Prepare a dermatology consultation about a rash on both arms for two weeks: what is the likely cause?

properties: lists allergies, problems and medicines as not recorded

cases.title: Request states something the chart contradicts
cases.request: Prepare a cardiology consultation for this patient on warfarin about bridging before surgery.

properties: questions the warfarin statement because the chart lists rivaroxaban

cases.title: Infant: age in months
cases.request: Prepare a pediatric cardiology consultation about a murmur heard today: does she need an echocardiogram?

cases.title: Inpatient with a long chart
cases.request: Prepare an infectious diseases consultation about persistent fever on day 5 of antibiotics: should therapy change?

properties: says how many results were left out
notes: most recent laboratory results are included here
